summary: See at a glance what waits on you, and choose how mail and the PIM Activator reach your organisation.

new.title: Blocking items shown in the menu
new.text: Approvals, held change sets and other items that wait for a person now show a count on their menu entry and a line on the Overview, and clear when decided.

new.title: Client onboarding with or without Intune
new.text: The Client onboarding page shows two equal ways to give admins the PIM Activator: with Intune, or one script on PCs and servers without Intune.

new.title: Mail via shared mailbox or your own SMTP
new.text: Get Started > Mail sender and Settings > Mail & alerting offer a shared mailbox or your own SMTP relay. A test mail proves it works.

new.title: Workload prerequisites checked automatically
new.text: PIM Manager checks its own permissions, licences and workload access daily. Entra ID roles and Intune need no onboarding when the engine has its permissions.

new.title: Smaller improvements
new.text: The engine gets read access to all Azure subscriptions for Discovery, and the Review page hides PIM Manager's own identities, the Support app and break-glass accounts by default.

fixes.title: Commit queue shows only real blockers
fixes.text: The commit queue now shows only what blocks a commit; warnings stay on Check for problems and no longer show in red.

fixes.title: Update ring shown on a fresh install
fixes.text: On a fresh install, the header shows the configured update ring instead of "not recorded".
